theme: Light theme only (User explicitly requested 'No dark/deep backgrounds')

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4. It provides a clean, approachable, organic tech feel suitable for a sustainability app.
headings.tracking: tracking-tight for H1-H2 to look premium

body.usage: Use for all body text, buttons, and inputs. Very readable, geometric, yet friendly.

rules: NO pure black. Text should be gray-900 or gray-800.
NO dark/deep backgrounds globally. Stick to light, fresh, airy palettes.
Use Mint/Emerald for main accents. Use waste category colors strictly for tagging chips/badges.

app_structure.user_app: Mobile-first view. On desktop, constrain the main app view to a max-width (e.g., max-w-md mx-auto) with a soft shadow to simulate a mobile app frame, or allow responsive grid expansion while keeping the bottom nav fixed for mobile.
app_structure.admin_dashboard: Standard 100vw layout. Sidebar on desktop (w-64), top header, and bento grid for main content area. Fully responsive.

layouts.hero_page: Full-screen beautiful environmental hero background. Use bg-cover bg-center with a subtle white/mint gradient overlay bg-gradient-to-t from-white/90 via-white/40 to-transparent so text is readable but image breathes.

navigation.user_mobile: Fixed bottom navigation bar. fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-gray-100 z-50 pb-safe.
navigation.admin: Left sidebar on desktop, hamburger off-canvas drawer on mobile.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards. Avoid cramped information.

grids.admin_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Dashboard stat cards span 1 column. Charts span 2-3 columns.
grids.user_cards: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 for recycling centers or waste logs.

component_guidelines.cards: Clean, bg-white, rounded-3xl for user app, rounded-2xl for admin. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] or shadow-sm. Soft and modern.
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped rounded-full for consumer app actions to feel friendly. rounded-lg for admin actions. Must have hover states: hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform.
component_guidelines.bottom_nav_items: Flex column, centered. Active state: text-emerald-600 with an emerald dot or underline. Inactive: text-gray-400.
component_guidelines.status_chips: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold. Use soft backgrounds (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 for Recyclable, etc.).
component_guidelines.smart_bins: Simulate fill levels using vertical or horizontal progress bars with colors changing based on level (Green < 50%, Yellow > 50%, Red > 90%). Add explicit text 'Simulated IoT Data'.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient and soft. Avoid harsh, tight shadows. Use shadow-[0_20px_40px_-15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] for floating elements.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use very subtle borders border border-gray-100 alongside soft shadows to define edges clearly.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use ONLY for sticky headers or bottom navigation: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b/t border-white/20. Never use transparent without blur.

motion.hover: Buttons and cards lift slightly: hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300 ease-out.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500 for main sections.
motion.scan_animation: When 'Scanning Waste', use a smooth sweeping line over the image animate-pulse and translate-y.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 or 2 for a clean, modern look. Keep them simple.
media.images: Use border-radius rounded-2xl for inline images. Ensure alt tags are descriptive.

hero_background.description: Lush forest background for the beautiful environmental hero page.

waste_scan_placeholder.description: Recycling bins for disposal assistant or scan placeholders.

impact_card.description: Hands holding a sprout, for Impact dashboard or EcoPoints.

community_park.description: Clean modern city park for the community reports section.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text has a dark overlay if placed over images. Use APCA contrast. Buttons must have at least 3:1 ratio.
accessibility.focus: All inputs and buttons must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='scan-button').

3d_libraries: Not recommended for this specific project as user requested 'Subtle animations only' and a fast, modern mobile app feel. Rely on crisp 2D CSS visuals, smooth transitions, and high-quality photography instead.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Manrope' and 'Figtree' in your index.html or import in CSS.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use Manrope.

For the user-facing mobile app views, use a layout that looks good on desktop but clearly mimics a mobile interface (e.g., max-w-md centered container for the app routes, or responsive grid that relies on bottom navigation for mobile and side nav for desktop).
Admin dashboard must be a separate route space (e.g., /admin) using a full 100vw layout.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them. NOTE: The project uses .js/.jsx, NOT .tsx. Install and configure Shadcn without TypeScript.
Do not build HTML datepickers or selects. Use Shadcn components for forms.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, links, and forms.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
NEVER use generic centered layouts for text reading. Left-align most content for better scanability.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, lightbulb, dart etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. User explicitly forbade dark/deep backgrounds.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for floating navs (12-24px blur).
Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input EXCLUDING transforms to avoid breaking.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
DO NOT use complete 'transparent' background in header or overlays. Ensure they are semi-solid or glass.
